Article 99 — Penalties (excerpt)
The regulation establishes a tiered penalty regime. Non-compliance with the prohibition of the AI practices referred to in Article 5 shall be subject to administrative fines of up to EUR 35 000 000 or, if the offender is an undertaking, up to 7 % of its total worldwide annual turnover for the preceding financial year, whichever is higher. Non-compliance with other obligations shall be subject to fines of up to EUR 15 000 000 or 3 %. The supply of incorrect, incomplete or misleading information to notified bodies or national competent authorities shall be subject to fines of up to EUR 7 500 000 or 1 %.
